title: Dream Job: A Short Film
description: My own story, told with AI: the dream of landing the perfect job, the reality of rejections and late-night applications, and the belief that every rejection is not the end. Sometimes it is preparation.
process: Written, planned and directed by me. Prompts crafted with ChatGPT, scenes generated in NoteGPT, and the short clips combined into one film in CapCut.
